title: 皐月賞の後に・4月の仇

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship avenges the month of April by claiming victory in the Satsuki Sho. She's also prepared to do it all again next year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Little does she know that she won't be eligible for the Satsuki Sho next year… but never mind that! Onward, Gold Shiiip!
